Plants of the World Online account: Ophrys × sommieri E.G.Camus ex Cortesi.

The native range of this hybrid is Medit. It is a tuberous geophyte and grows primarily in the subtropical biome. The hybrid formula is O. bombyliflora × O. tenthredinifera.
